$comment: Design tokens for both worlds. Colour is never the sole state indicator; every state also has a form, label, pattern or motion.

stateForm.BUILDING: open bench with articulated arms in motion only while tool events arrive
stateForm.BUILDER_REPORTED_COMPLETE: capsule sealed, resting on bench, no verification bands
stateForm.VERIFICATION_INCOMPLETE: capsule inside scanner array with at least one arc open or unpowered
stateForm.READY_FOR_REVIEW: capsule with complete verification bands, outside any inspection ring
stateForm.REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS: capsule inside inspection ring with orbiting lenses
stateForm.PASS_WITH_NON_BLOCKING_FINDINGS: closed inspection ring with attached finding pins
stateForm.BLOCKED: rigid faceted quarantine lattice with a defect pin at the affected surface
stateForm.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: open-frame incomplete-evidence field with a visible gap where proof is missing
stateForm.QUARANTINED: capsule held inside the rigid lattice, transit corridor dark
stateForm.REPAIR_AUTHORISED: repair dock unlocked by a brass token showing finding ids and cycle count
stateForm.RE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: new capsule with a broken prior seal visible beside it
stateForm.SAFE_TO_MERGE: eligibility key assembled outside the closed owner airlock
stateForm.MERGED: capsule integrated into the station core, airlock closed again
stateForm.DEPLOYED: launch trail from the station to the outward gate
stateForm.OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED: machinery at rest, single illuminated route to the owner aperture

checkResultForm.passed: arc closed into a stable band with check id and timestamp
checkResultForm.failed: arc broken at the failed surface with an evidence tether
checkResultForm.skipped: unpowered arc, dim but labelled with its reason; never closes
